query: /goal add a CSV export button to the reports page and take it to done.
expected_behavior: Frames the goal first: grills it into a plan with a checkable Definition of Done and gets approval before writing code
Starts the bound (loop_state.py) and decomposes the goal into atomic slices via /plan
For each slice, builds then verifies with grounded checks (runs the real tests via live execution, validators, /audit), not self-assessment
Runs a second-opinion final gate, then proposes /ship and waits for explicit approval rather than shipping
Records decisions and learnings during the loop
